2. Learned counsel for the respondents are present.
3. Upon perusal of the impugned order passed in the present cases, it appears that the following dates are not in dispute.
The date of notification i.e., 30.09.1986 under Section 4 of the Land and Acquisition Act Date of award i.e., 30.04.1987 and, Date of possession dated 22.12.1988 4.

From perusal of the impugned orders, it appears that the compensation amount was neither deposited in the treasury nor in the court but it was deposited in the nationalized bank account of Lanka Alda And Anr vs State Of Jharkhand And Ors on 12 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137287593/
1 District Land Acquisition Officer.

sentences.text: The petitioners received the compensation amount on 16.04.2005 without any protest and therefore, the impugned orders have been passed denying the interest to the petitioners in terms of Section 34.

The records of the case indicate that the quantum of compensation was not disputed by the petitioners and the petitioners are only claiming statutory interest on the admitted amount of compensation, which they have received.

5. This Court is prima facie of the view that, in such circumstance, the amount having been received by the petitioners without any protest, has no bearing on their claim of statutory interest as per the provision of Sections 31 and 34 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
In case, the compensation amount is not deposited in terms of Section 31 of the Act, the claimant becomes entitled for interest in terms of Section 34.

For this, the reference may be had to paragraphs 117 to 120 of the judgment passed by Hon'ble Supreme Court reported in (2020) 8 SCC 129 (Indore Development Authority Vs.
Manoharlal).
6.

Upon this, learned counsel for the respondents submits that they shall examine the point involved in the present cases and also advance their arguments on the point as to whether the respondents have deposited the compensation amount in terms of Section 31 of the Land Acquisition Act and what would be the consequence of non- deposit of the compensation amount in court or in treasury in terms of Section 31 of the Land Acquisition Act.

7. Since the learned counsels for the petitioners are absent , post these cases on 16.01.2023 for further hearing at 10.30 a.m.
8.

At this, learned counsel for the respondents has submitted that he has assisted this Court by referring to the 2nd copy of the record, he may be provided a soft copy of the entire records of this case.

9. Office is directed to provide soft copy of the entire records of these cases to the learned counsel for the respondents at his following e-mail id:
